title: ATCSCC Advisory
content_html:
ATCSCC Advisory
ATCSCC ADVZY 111 DCC 11/13/2026 NATIONAL GROUND STOP

MESSAGE: 

 
EVENT TIME: 13/2053 - 14/0400
DUE TO EXTRAORDINARY CIRCUMSTANCES AND FOR REASONS OF SAFETY.
ATTENTION ALL AIRCRAFT OPERATORS, BY ORDER OF THE FEDERAL AVIATION
COMMAND CENTER ALL AIRPORTS ARE GROUND STOPPED. ALL DEPARTING
TRAFFIC SHOULD REMAIN GROUND STOPPED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. INBOUND
INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS WILL BE MANAGED ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS.  

EFFECTIVE TIME: 

 132054-140430

SIGNATURE: 

 26/11/13 20:54
